name: Ember News Ticker & Scrolling Text
author: ember

sections.description:
Ember News Ticker is a WordPress news ticker for bringing your posts and announcements together in one place. Create a scrolling news ticker from your own text or existing blog posts, then choose its appearance and placement. Check the live preview as you edit.

Ember News Ticker Pro
Add RSS feeds, WooCommerce products, custom post type content, scheduled placement and live content refresh with the separate Pro add-on. Explore Ember News Ticker Pro.

Build a news ticker from your own content

Share breaking news or a service update with a message and an optional link. Use the rich text editor for formatted copy, or add HTML and output from another shortcode. Combine these sources with WordPress posts in the same ticker and arrange the content in the order you choose.

Each content component can be enabled or disabled independently. A post query stays together at its position in the ticker, so you can put an announcement before a group of headlines and a promotional message after them.

Turn your latest posts into a post ticker

Keep readers aware of new articles with a latest posts ticker. Select posts automatically, filter them by category or tag, and choose the number of results and their order. You can also handpick posts and arrange them yourself.

Post titles link to the original articles. Add a featured image, publication date or category when that context helps readers decide what to open. Free includes regular WordPress posts; Pro adds content from other post types.

Choose how your scrolling text moves

Use continuous horizontal scrolling for a marquee or text ticker. Set the direction and speed to suit your content. Sliding and fading show one item at a time, with configurable timing and transition duration.

Pause on hover is configurable per ticker. Motion pauses when keyboard focus enters the ticker, and the frontend respects the visitor’s reduced motion preference. Slide and fade tickers can display navigation arrows.

Place your news ticker where readers will see it

Add a ticker shortcode to your content, insert the Gutenberg ticker block, or select a saved ticker in the Elementor news ticker widget. These manual embeds use the same content and design as automatic bars.

For a sitewide message, enable automatic placement at the top or bottom of your site. Choose a fixed position to keep a promotional bar visible as visitors scroll, or use normal page flow. Fixed bars reserve their height by default and account for the WordPress admin bar at the top.

Include or exclude selected pages with display conditions. Any matching exclusion takes priority. These conditions apply to automatic placement; shortcode, block and Elementor embeds remain independent of them. Empty news tickers render no bar or reserved space.

Style scrolling text to fit your site

Give each ticker its own colors and typography. Adjust its height, corner radius and spacing, then choose a label and separators. Starter presets provide editable content and design settings you can use as a starting point.

Use a breaking news ticker on a publication, a promotional bar for an offer, or a notification bar for opening hours and service updates. Each ticker keeps its settings separate, so several embeds can have different designs.

Manage and move your tickers

Create multiple tickers from the Ember News Ticker dashboard. Duplicate an existing ticker as a draft or disable it while keeping its settings. Content, design, animation and placement are configured in the individual ticker editor.

Ticker import export uses JSON files. Imported tickers start as drafts for review. Site-specific content and media references need to be checked when moving a setup to another website.

Ember News Ticker Pro news ticker features

Ember News Ticker Pro is a separate add-on that requires the free plugin. It adds RSS feed headlines and WooCommerce product offers, plus automatic or handpicked content from a selected post type. Promo items pair an image with a heading and supporting text. Individual component colors let you override the ticker’s text and link colors.

Pro also adds scheduling and device targeting for automatic placement. CSS-selector placement inserts a ticker relative to a matching page element. Live content refresh updates automatically sourced items without a page reload. Additional presets and horizontal reveal or typewriter animations use the same ticker editor and renderer.

Full Ember News Ticker feature list

  • Simple text – Publish a message with an optional link.
  • Rich text – Format copy and links with the WordPress editor.
  • HTML content – Add custom markup as a ticker item.
  • Shortcode content – Display content supplied by another shortcode.
  • WordPress post ticker – Show automatic or handpicked posts.
  • Category and tag filters – Narrow the posts selected for your ticker.
  • Post details – Include optional featured images, dates and categories.
  • Mixed content – Keep messages and post results in your chosen order.
  • Continuous scrolling text – Set horizontal direction and scroll speed.
  • Slide and fade – Control item timing and transition duration.
  • Hover pause – Choose whether pointer hover pauses animation.
  • Keyboard focus pause – Pause motion while a visitor focuses a ticker link.
  • Ticker styling – Adjust colors, typography, height and spacing per ticker.
  • Labels and separators – Identify your ticker and separate scrolling items.
  • Navigation arrows – Let visitors move between slide or fade items.
  • Starter presets – Apply an editable ticker setup.
  • Ticker shortcode – Embed a saved ticker with its shortcode.
  • Gutenberg ticker block – Select a ticker in the WordPress block editor.
  • Elementor news ticker – Place a saved ticker through the Elementor widget.
  • Top and bottom bars – Display tickers automatically in fixed or normal positions.
  • Page conditions – Include or exclude pages from automatic placement.
  • Ticker management – Create, duplicate or disable tickers from the dashboard.
  • Import and export – Move ticker configurations with JSON files.
  • Pro content sources – Add RSS, custom post type content, Promo and WooCommerce products.
  • Pro placement controls – Add schedules, device targeting and CSS-selector placement.
  • Pro live refresh – Update automatically sourced content without reloading the page.
  • Pro design options – Add component colors, presets, reveal and typewriter animations.

Ember News Ticker resources and branding

Ember News Ticker is developed by EmberWP. Use Ember News Ticker when referring to the plugin.

Visit the product page or learn how to create your first ticker.

Comparing news ticker tools

If you are comparing Ditty, Common Ninja, Elfsight or POWR, Ember News Ticker offers a WordPress-based workflow for saved tickers with mixed content and page placement. Choose the free plugin for text and post tickers, or add Pro for external feeds and additional placement controls.

Source Code and Build Instructions

Readable JavaScript, React, SCSS and preset sources are included in assets/src/. The plugin also includes package.json, package-lock.json and scripts/package-plugin.js so you can reproduce its bundled assets. No Node.js tools are needed to use the installed plugin.

To build from the plugin directory, use Node.js 22.13.0 or newer and npm 8.19.2 or newer:

  1. Run npm ci to install the locked dependencies.
  2. Run npm run build to compile the dashboard, ticker editor, frontend and block assets into assets/build/.

For development, run npm run start to watch dashboard, editor and frontend sources, and npm run start:blocks in a second terminal to watch the block source.

To create a release ZIP at a chosen location, run npm run build followed by node scripts/package-plugin.js /absolute/path/to/ember-news-ticker.zip. The output path must be outside the plugin directory. In the project’s Local site layout, npm run zip builds and saves the archive in the site’s releases/ directory. Release archives include readable sources and build tools, while excluding installed Node dependencies, tests, contributor notes and Finder metadata.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ember-news-ticker folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Ember News Ticker.
  3. Open Ember News Ticker in the admin menu and create or edit a ticker.
  4. Add content, adjust its design and animation, then publish and enable the ticker.
  5. Insert its shortcode, select it in the Ember News Ticker block or Elementor widget, or enable automatic top/bottom placement.

For example, use [tickerpress id="123"], replacing 123 with your ticker’s ID.
sections.faq:
Can I use Ember News Ticker without Pro?

Yes. Free includes text, rich text, HTML, shortcode content and WordPress posts. Styling, the three core animation modes, page conditions and import/export are included.

Can I combine posts and custom messages?

Yes. Add several content components and arrange them in one ticker. Automatic post results remain consecutive at their component’s position.

Does Ember News Ticker include a scrolling news ticker?

Yes. Choose continuous horizontal scrolling for a scrolling news ticker. You can also select horizontal slide or fade. Static and vertical modes are not available.

Can I use a block or Elementor widget?

Yes. Free includes the Ember News Ticker block and an Elementor widget. Elementor needs to be installed and active to use its widget. The shortcode works independently of Elementor.

Why is my ticker not visible?

Check that the ticker is published, enabled and contains usable content. For automatic bars, check placement and page conditions too. Empty tickers are hidden. If more than one automatic ticker matches a position, only the last matching ticker is selected.

Do page conditions affect manually embedded tickers?

No. Page conditions apply only to automatic bars. Shortcodes, blocks and Elementor widgets ignore those conditions. Pro scheduling and device targeting also apply only to automatic placement.

Can I display RSS feeds or WooCommerce products?

These are Pro content sources. Install Ember News Ticker Pro alongside Free. WooCommerce must also be active for the product source.

Can I import tickers from another plugin?

Import/export supports Ember News Ticker JSON files. It does not currently migrate tickers from other plugins. Imported tickers are drafts, and references to content on a different site require review.

Does the plugin load frontend assets on every page?

Frontend assets load when a ticker is rendered or an eligible automatic placement needs them. The frontend ticker does not require React.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with mixed ticker content, scrolling/slide/fade animations, manual and automatic placement, and import/export.
